verdict.rationale: The RELEASE-NOTES.md shows steady, substantive releases: new harness support (Devin CLI, Hermes Agent, Grok Build CLI, Antigravity marketplace manifest), bug fixes (worktree removal no longer destroying untracked files, plan-scoped workspace fixing ledger cross-reading) and workflow rework. A community comment independently notes a recent update that changed self-review behavior. Nothing in the pack covers issue triage or merged community contributions, and none of the releases are dated. Missing for 10: release dates/cadence evidence, issue triage activity, evidence of accepted community PRs/contributors.
